Description: Opt-in read-only PostgreSQL event handler with runtime-pinned encrypted parameter access and retained alias rollback.

ref.has: Bootstrap, ownership, release and deletion constraints
Offline preparation, learner-only publication, exact runtime and secret-version binding

must: Update the existing backend stack; preserve function logical identity and signed CloudFront origin.
Only learner-created Standard SecureString under AWS-managed alias/aws/ssm; no secret value in template or environment.
Use eu-north-1, exact same-account parameter and the accepted account-cap-ten mode; validate target before publication.

PackageBucket.Description: Artifact bucket from the storage stack.

PackageSha256.Description: Base64 SHA-256 of the actual ZIP.

AllowedOrigin.Description: Exact reviewed CloudFront HTTPS origin; no bootstrap origin for this opt-in runtime.

BackendRevision.Description: SHA-256 binds exact ZIP and canonical runtime config including account, origin, pooled endpoint and pinned parameter version.

ConcurrencyMode.Description: No default. reserved-two needs available quota; shared account-cap-five or account-cap-ten needs explicit acceptance and fresh matching quota evidence.

RollbackVersion.Description: Existing version of this same function for alias-only rollback; empty selects this revision.

NeonHost.Description: Confirmed Frankfurt pooled hostname only; no URI or port.

NeonUser.Description: Existing restricted read-only application role; never the owner.

NeonPasswordParameterVersion.Description: Explicit immutable parameter version; never latest or a label.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Own the log group before invocation so the execution role needs no CreateLogGroup permission.
must: Seven-day retention; no ticket bodies or credentials in logs.
Delete this temporary diagnostic group during explicit teardown; no application records belong here.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Keep existing role/log permissions and add one named GetParameter operation; same-account aws/ssm provides default key access.
must: Only the exact production password parameter may be read; no list, history, writes, wildcard retrieval or customer-managed key permissions.
Keep the documented Lambda service trust unchanged; actual SCP/IAM/KMS availability must be verified before publication.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: No HTTP listener/VPC/NAT or new database. Lazy verified pooled TLS reads reuse an initialized bounded pool across warm invocations.
must: No password or dynamic secret reference in the environment; AWS_REGION is provided by Lambda.
Pool max two; database operations at most eight seconds, secret request at most three seconds, total request at most 25 seconds and bounded by Lambda remaining time.
Only SELECT role and parameterized bounded reads; no fixture fallback.
Preserve explicit accepted account-cap-ten choice, runtime architecture, handler identity and stack-owned logs.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Replacement snapshots bundled code and nonsecret configuration including the pinned parameter version; retain earlier versions for deliberate rollback.
must: Change BackendRevision whenever ZIP or any runtime configuration changes.
Retain the existing logical identity, retained versions and stack-managed alias rollback.
An old Lambda version still needs a compatible database password/SSM version; alias rollback alone cannot undo credential rotation.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: A stable alias keeps the URL unchanged and supports rollback through stack parameters without out-of-band alias drift.
must: RollbackVersion must be verified as a retained version of this function.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Only signed origin requests reach the read-only API; edge stack owns distribution-scoped invoke grants.
must: No NONE auth or duplicate CORS settings.
URL qualifier is the stable alias name.

FunctionName.Description: Owned function name for checks and teardown.

AliasArn.Description: Live alias ARN for distribution permissions.

Version.Description: Published revision version, even when live alias is rolled back.
